name: TN-06
label: Safe R

model.rationale: The R+13 district and a massive fundraising gap—Garrett has raised $2.4M with outside support while Croley has under $40K—make a Democratic upset implausible. Markets price the Republican at roughly 94%, consistent with a Likely R rating on an open seat.
model.watch: A late Democratic fundraising surge or nationalized environment shift could narrow the margin, but the structural lean makes an upset unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: John Rose (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
This open Nashville-area seat leans firmly Republican, with a partisan baseline of R+13. John Rose's retirement to run for governor removes the incumbent, but the Republican side holds every structural advantage. State Representative Johnny Garrett has raised over $2.3 million and drawn outside support, while Democrat Mike Croley has raised about $35,000 with minimal cash on hand.

Prediction markets price the Republican at roughly 94 percent, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. The forecast sits near the fundamentals-based estimate of a mid-teens Republican margin, with uncertainty widened slightly by the open seat and absence of polling.
